$comment: Same tokens as the other worlds; the one accent means only: this waits for you. external_url: a template with {external_id} turns the order number into a link into the organisation's order system; empty in the demo.

onsite.$comment: The assessor's view at the car (tablet, phone): photos by view, a note, the AI's hints in rounds. stages: where it opens; series: the numbered photo slots; views: the photo standard R-02 (required) plus the detail shots; note: where the note lands (it becomes the dictation); helper: the skill asked; close: the action that ends the inspection.
